records.jp: ここはいろんな本が集まってるし、<CR>無限に時間が潰せる気がするね
records.en_original: Look at all these books... I bet you could spend forever in here reading.
records.en: Look at all these books... I bet you could spend forever in here reading.

records.jp: これだけの数があると、<CR>何年かかっても読み終わらなさそう……
records.en_original: Right? I don't think you could ever read them all, even if you had all the time in the world…
records.en: Right? I don't think you could ever read them all, even if you had all the time in the world…

records.jp: そのくらいの方がいいよ！<CR>ずーっと楽しめるしね
records.en_original: That's how it should be! You'd never get bored!
records.en: That's how it should be! You'd never get bored!

records.jp: ここ、結構漫画も多いんだよね
records.en_original: Ooh, there's a lot of manga here too...
records.en: Ooh, there's a lot of manga here too...

records.jp: そうなんだよ！<CR>意外と読みやすい本も多くて
records.en_original: Yeah! It's not just the boring, hard-to-read stuff.
records.en: Yeah! It's not just the boring, hard-to-read stuff.

records.jp: 勇希も漫画読むんだっけ？
records.en_original: Do you like manga too, Yuki?
records.en: Do you like manga too, Yuki?

records.jp: 読む読む！
records.en_original: Yup!
records.en: Yup!

records.jp: あたし、小説とか集中力持たないから<CR>読むの苦手なんだよね
records.en_original: I have trouble focusing when I read stuff like novels, so I like manga better.
records.en: I have trouble focusing when I read stuff like novels, so I like manga better.

records.jp: 愛央はどう？
records.en_original: What about you, Ao?
records.en: What about you, Ao?

records.jp: 私も漫画ばっかりかなー
records.en_original: I pretty much only read manga...
records.en: I pretty much only read manga...

records.jp: 親近感～。やっぱそうだよね
records.en_original: Ahh, I knew there was a reason I liked you!
records.en: Ahh, I knew there was a reason I liked you!

records.jp: 漫画も小説も、面白ければ何でも読むよ！
records.en_original: Manga, novels—I'll read anything as long as it's interesting!
records.en: Manga, novels—I'll read anything as long as it's interesting!

records.jp: うわ、すごー！　活字読める人ソンケーするなぁ
records.en_original: Whoa, that's awesome! I really admire people who can get through pages and pages of nothing but text.
records.en: Whoa, that's awesome! I really admire people who can get through pages and pages of nothing but text.

records.jp: もっぱらラノベだけどね
records.en_original: ...Though it's mostly YA novels, to be honest.
records.en: ...Though it's mostly YA novels, to be honest.

records.jp: さて、私も何か探そうかな～
records.en_original: Okay, let's see...
records.en: Okay, let's see...

records.jp: あ、そうだ！　いいこと思いついた
records.en_original: Oh! I just thought of something fun!
records.en: Oh! I just thought of something fun!

records.jp: 何？
records.en_original: Yeah?
records.en: Yeah?

records.jp: 二人で別々の漫画を読んで、<CR>面白かったやつを教え合うってどう？
records.en_original: We can each read different manga, then swap the ones we think are good!
records.en: We can each read different manga, then swap the ones we think are good!

records.jp: そうすれば、<CR>面白い作品を探すスピードも二倍になるでしょ？
records.en_original: That way we can find a new fave in half the time!
records.en: That way we can find a new fave in half the time!

records.jp: おお……。勇希にしては合理的な考え方
records.en_original: Ooh, that sounds good! That's a pretty logical idea for you, Yuki!
records.en: Ooh, that sounds good! That's a pretty logical idea for you, Yuki!

records.jp: 「勇希にしては」が余計だけど？
records.en_original: For me?! Why would you say it like that?
records.en: "For Yuki" was unnecessary, you know?

records.jp: いいと思うよ。私も探してくるね
records.en_original: It was a compliment! All right, I'm gonna look over on that shelf.
records.en: It was a compliment! All right, I'm gonna look over on that shelf.

records.jp: オッケー。それじゃ探索開始！
records.en_original: Sure. Let the hunt begin!
records.en: Sure. Let the hunt begin!

records.jp: 愛央、何か見つけた？
records.en_original: Find anything good, Ao?
records.en: Find anything good, Ao?

records.jp: うん。私のおすすめは――
records.en_original: Yeah. I think you'd like...
records.en: Yeah. I think you'd like...

records.jp: このバトル漫画かな！
records.en_original: This battle manga!
records.en: This battle manga!

records.jp: おお、少年誌系の？
records.en_original: Oh, an action manga?
records.en: Oh, an action manga?

records.jp: うん。でも女の子が読んでもちゃんと熱いよ！
records.en_original: Yeah. It's actually a good one, though! It's got a little bit of everything.
records.en: Yeah. It's actually a good one, though! It's got a little bit of everything.

records.jp: 愛央、こういうの好きだよね。<CR>異能力とかで戦うやつ
records.en_original: I didn't realize you were into superpowers and battles and stuff, Ao.
records.en: I didn't realize you were into superpowers and battles and stuff, Ao.

records.jp: い、いいじゃん！<CR>だって、かっこいいんだもん……
records.en_original: Y-yeah, so what?! I think it's cool...
records.en: Y-yeah, so what?! I think it's cool...

records.jp: 責めてないって！　あたしも読んでみるからさ
records.en_original: I'm not saying it's a bad thing! Pass it here, I wanna read it.
records.en: I'm not saying it's a bad thing! Pass it here, I wanna read it.

records.jp: このスポーツ漫画かな！
records.en_original: This sports manga!
records.en: This sports manga!

records.jp: へえ、野球ものかぁ
records.en_original: Oh, baseball, huh?
records.en: Oh, baseball, huh?

records.jp: ルール分かんなくてもちゃんと読めるよ。<CR>私もよく分かんないまま読んでる！
records.en_original: Yeah. But it doesn't get too far into all the technical stuff. I don't know anything about baseball, but I could read it just fine.
records.en: Yeah. But it doesn't get too far into all the technical stuff. I don't know anything about baseball, but I could read it just fine.

records.jp: 愛央ってこういう泥臭い感じのも好きなんだね
records.en_original: I didn't realize you were into all that nitty-gritty action!
records.en: I didn't realize you were into all that nitty-gritty action!

records.jp: スポーツとか、ろくにやったことないからこそ、<CR>こういうのに憧れちゃうのかも？
records.en_original: I never really did any sports, so maybe that's why I think it's cool...
records.en: I never really did any sports, so maybe that's why I think it's cool...

records.jp: じゃあ次、勇希のおすすめ教えてよ
records.en_original: Your turn, Yuki. What did you find?
records.en: Your turn, Yuki. What did you find?

records.jp: あたしはね……これ
records.en_original: Check this out...
records.en: Check this out...

records.jp: これは……少女漫画？<CR>しかも、結構乙女なタイプの……
records.en_original: A...high school manga? And a pretty girly one at that...
records.en: A...high school manga? And a pretty girly one at that...

records.jp: どういうところが好きなの？
records.en_original: What did you like about it?
records.en: What did you like about it?

records.en_original: Well, uh...
records.en: Well, uh...

records.jp: 笑わない？
records.en_original: Don't laugh, okay?
records.en: Don't laugh, okay?

records.jp: 笑わないよ
records.en_original: Promise.
records.en: Promise.

records.jp: ……こういう学生生活送りたいなーって、<CR>夢を見せてくれるところ
records.en_original: It's just so...normal. I always wanted to go to school like a normal kid, so it let me fulfill that fantasy.
records.en: It's just so...normal. I always wanted to go to school like a normal kid, so it let me fulfill that fantasy.

records.jp: なるほど、結構自己投影型だ？
records.en_original: I see... I didn't realize you were such a dreamer.
records.en: I see... I didn't realize you were such a dreamer.

records.jp: あ、あたしだって年頃の女の子ですし！<CR>そういう妄想くらい、するし……
records.en_original: I-I mean, I'm still young! I'm allowed to let my imagination run wild…
records.en: I-I mean, I'm still young! I'm allowed to let my imagination run wild…

records.jp: 分かるよ。私もするもん
records.en_original: Don't worry, I get it. I do too.
records.en: Don't worry, I get it. I do too.

records.jp: そ、そうなんだ。ちょっと意外……かも？
records.en_original: O-oh yeah? That's kinda...unexpected.
records.en: O-oh yeah? That's kinda...unexpected.

records.jp: 勇希が話してくれたから私も言うことにした。<CR>……やっぱちょっと恥ずかしいね
records.en_original: Well, you opened up to me, so I thought I should do the same. It is a bit embarrassing to say out loud, though...
records.en: Well, you opened up to me, so I thought I should do the same. It is a bit embarrassing to say out loud, though...

records.jp: ……えへへ
records.en_original: ...Eheheh.
records.en: ...Eheheh.

records.jp: 実は……私、こういうのも結構好きなんだよね
records.en_original: Well, actually... I'm really into this kind of stuff.
records.en: Well, actually... I'm really into this kind of stuff.

records.jp: ほ、ホント！？
records.en_original: S-seriously?!
records.en: S-seriously?!

records.jp: うん。あんまり恥ずかしいから言わないけど……
records.en_original: It's true. I don't really tell people, though...
records.en: It's true. I don't really tell people, though...

records.jp: そうだったんだ……。<CR>完全に自分の好みで選んだけど、意外な結果だ！
records.en_original: No way... I just picked it out 'cause I thought I'd like it. That works out great!
records.en: No way... I just picked it out 'cause I thought I'd like it. That works out great!

records.jp: もしかして……趣味合う？
records.en_original: I guess we have similar tastes, huh?
records.en: I guess we have similar tastes, huh?

records.jp: あはは、かもね
records.en_original: Ahaha, Sure seems like it!
records.en: Ahaha, Sure seems like it!

records.jp: ふー、たくさん読んだな～
records.en_original: Whew... My eyes are tired from all that reading.
records.en: Whew... My eyes are tired from all that reading.

records.jp: たまにはこうやってのんびり読書もいいかもね
records.en_original: It's nice to laze around and just read every once in a while.
records.en: It's nice to laze around and just read every once in a while.

records.jp: じゃあさ、今度ここに布団持ってきて<CR>ゴロゴロしながら本読んじゃおうよ！
records.en_original: Ooh, we should bring a bunch of blankets and pillows next time!
records.en: Ooh, we should bring a bunch of blankets and pillows next time!

records.jp: それいいね。もっとのんびりできそう
records.en_original: Now that sounds like a plan. We'll really be lazing around then!
records.en: Now that sounds like a plan. We'll really be lazing around then!

records.jp: のんびりしすぎて寝ちゃいそうだけど
records.en_original: Yeah... Knowing us, we'll just end up falling asleep.
records.en: Yeah... Knowing us, we'll just end up falling asleep.

records.jp: ふふっ！
records.en_original: Hehe.
records.en: Hehe.

records.jp: あははっ！
records.en_original: Ahaha!
records.en: Ahaha!
